name: gemready
description: GemReady — condition estimates, centering and grading outcomes for trading cards.

scripts.start: npm run sync && cd backend && npm start
scripts.dev: npm run sync && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.test: npm run check && cd shared && node --test test/*.test.js && cd ../backend && npm test && cd ../model && python3 -m unittest test_train.py
scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run sync && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
